title: Spatial ligand-receptor analysis of human striatal zones (Slide-tags): code release
description: R code for the spatially constrained ligand-receptor analysis comparing striatal Zone 1 and Zone 4 in human Slide-tags data (CellChat v2 database; radius, fixed-neighbor and density-matched sensitivity arms; donor-paired tests with permutation-null robustness), with figure scripts. Accompanies Kraft, Lee et al., Mesoscale molecular architecture of the striatum across cell types and adult aging, Cell (2026).
